Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::modifyCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		cashier.Name = name and
		result = true or
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
